notes.title: X Mutation: New Character & Co-op Mode Progress Update!
notes.content:
X Mutation Update: New Character & Co-op Mode Progress! 🚀
Hello X Mutation fans! 👋

We know it’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work on two exciting new features for the game: a brand new character and Co-op multiplayer mode!

💥 New Character Progress
We’ve completed the modeling and rigging, and we’re currently working on skills! This new character will bring fresh gameplay mechanics and offer a whole new experience when you step into the battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/8fba7688d2f80f80bbde7feb00a48784fafcdc69.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/277b714facdc99060a31afc78b151d621f7fb08d.jpg[/img]

🤝 Co-op Mode Progress
We’ve successfully finished the lobby system and made great strides in connecting players through Steam for seamless co-op gameplay. You’ll soon be able to team up with friends and take on the challenges of X Mutation together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/823492fc65baf0092d2121acc058162979137399.jpg[/img]


🚧 What’s Next?
We’re still putting the finishing touches on both features, and we can’t wait to show you more. Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks of what’s to come! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these new additions, and we can’t thank you enough for your support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/3fee55f90eafb1b75ca4a174db0b8788122b61bd.png[/img]



Thank you for your continued support and for being part of the X Mutation journey!

Best,
Projext X

notes.title: Co-op mode and a unique new character!
notes.content:
[h1]Upcoming Features:[/h1]

Over the next month, we are excited to focus on developing two significant new features:

[h3]New Character Introduction:[/h3]
Get ready to meet a brand new character complete with unique mutations and a fresh control system. This isn't just a model replacement; it's an entirely new gameplay experience! Here's a sneak peek at the character sketch:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922022/8be3e91c25e3ff76289c3c741c5a5302ca9a2411.jpg[/img]

[h3]Co-op Mode:[/h3]
Soon, you'll be able to team up and play with friends. We believe adding cooperative gameplay will make the game even more enjoyable!

[h3]Continued Support and Update Schedule:[/h3]
As we dedicate our efforts to developing the exciting new features, we will continue to address bugs and enhance the game through smaller updates. Please note that our update frequency may decrease over the next month, as our small team of two focuses on these major enhancements.

We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to make the game even better. Stay tuned for the updates, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch v0.2.46
notes.content:
[h3]Game Update Highlights:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Mutation Level and Stats Adjustment: We've reduced the maximum level of mutations to 5 and doubled the stat upgrades. Based on player feedback, we've rebalanced the game to ease the early stages, challenge the later stages, and quicken the overall pace.
[*] Hell Mode Timing Change: Hell mode now starts at 40 minutes.
[*] Upgrade Logic Enhancement: Improved the logic behind random upgrade options for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] New Option to Skip Level-ups: Added a "Skip Level-ups for the Remainder of the Match" checkbox, available once most mutations are fully upgraded.
[*] Bug Fix on Results Screen: Resolved an issue where the results screen could freeze.
[*] Mutation Stat Rebalance: Adjusted the stats of some mutations to enhance game balance.
[/list]
[h3]We Value Your Feedback and we react ligtning fast:[/h3]
[b]If you have any feedback or suggestions about the balance adjustments, please join our Discord to discuss with us and contribute to further improvements: Join Our Discord.[/b]

notes.title: Unleash Creativity with Our New Steam Workshop Integration!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the launch of our[b] Steam Workshop[/b] feature! Now, you can dive deeper into customization and share your unique gameplay experiences with the entire community.

[h3]What’s New?[/h3]

[h3]Share Your Gameplay Settings: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You now have the power to adjust and share settings for all game mechanics. Tailor your game to your style and let others enjoy your unique setups.
[*] Add Localizations: Help us make the game accessible to a wider audience by contributing your local translations. Your input can make our game global!
[/list]

[h3]Coming Soon: Design Your Own Mutations![/h3]
We’re currently developing a groundbreaking tool that will allow you to design and share your own mutations. Just like us, you’ll be able to create unique mutations that can be used in battle by players worldwide. Stay tuned—this feature will be available very soon!

Embrace your creativity and start shaping the game. We can't wait to see what you come up with!

notes.title: Patch v0.2.41.0: Customize Everything Now!
notes.content:
[h3]The major change in 0.2.41.0 is the introduction of the Customize Battle System! [/h3]
With the new customization panel, you can adjust virtually everything – from enemy and level settings to upgrade preferences, running speed, jump height, boss count, maximum level of mutations, stat increments upon leveling up mutations, terrain height, and much more. We offer 30 options for you to explore and adjust.

[h3]Another significant update is the addition of a training map designed specifically for new players.[/h3]

[b]We've also doubled the EXP gained from each battle, and the talent map now boosts your stats by 50%-100% more.[/b]

[h3]Other fixes include:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a UI indicator to show when the mutation crate will spawn, located at the top left corner of the screen.
[*] Changed the first weapon acquisition to be via a mutation crate, offering three options to choose from.
[*] Removed the possibility of acquiring useless tags for enchantments.
[*] Provided two ban points to start with.
[*] Enhanced jumping mechanics.
[*] Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.
[*] Corrected some descriptions for buffs.
[*] Fixed various bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.2.28 Update Notes
notes.content:
v0.2.28 Update Notes:

[list]
[*] Synthesis system got a makeover! Now, when merging mutations, you won't lose your passive abilities. Instead, they'll be merged by the "Heart."
[*] Legendary mutations got an upgrade—they're now glowing red and ready to rock!
[*] Now, you can wield both primary and secondary weapons simultaneously.
[*] Brace yourselves for 4 brand-new Bosses.
[*] We've added an in-battle Auto Save/Load system, so you never lose progress.
[*] Need to ban or unban mutations in a jiffy? Now you can with our new shortcut keys.
[*] Good news for SteamDeck players—enjoy an enhanced gaming experience.
[*] Our title page got a facelift, and the text content got spruced up too.
[*] Performance upgrades mean smoother gameplay all around.
[*] Animations got a tune-up, and Boss AI got smarter.
[*] When rerolling rank, the lowest number you can get is now (current rank -1).
[*] Now the main character in the title page will reflect the mutations you had in the latest battle.
[*] Bug fixes and improvements across the board.
[/list]

notes.title: Join the Adventure: Seeking 20 New Testers for X-Mutation's Latest Update! 🎮
notes.content:
Hello, X-Mutation community!

Thanks to the fantastic feedback from our initial round of testing, we've made a lot exciting improvements and are thrilled to announce that a new version of X-Mutation is now live! For a sneak peek at what's changed, check out our latest promo post right here on Steam.

But here's where the adventure really begins: 
[b]We're looking for 20 new players to join our testing brigade! [/b]This is your chance to dive into X-Mutation and help shape its future with your insights and feedback.

[b]What’s New?[/b]
[list]
[*] We've balanced, tweaked, and polished, all based on player feedback.
[*] New features and surprises await, ready for you to discover.
[/list]

[b]Tester Perks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Early access to the latest version of X-Mutation.
[*] A chance to leave your mark on the game with direct feedback to the development team.
[/list]

[b]How to Apply: [/b]
Send an email to projectx1901@gmail.com with answers to the following questions:
[list]
[*] Are you a fan of action roguelite games?
[*] Which action roguelite games have you played before, and approximately how many hours have you spent on them?
[/list]

tags.feature: New features and surprises await, ready for you to discover.

notes.title: Update v0.2.15: Major Enhancements and New Features!
notes.content:
Following the invaluable insights from our first round of private testing, we're excited to unveil substantial updates to X-Mutation! These enhancements are designed to make your gaming experience even more thrilling:

[list]
[*] [b]Game Rebalancing: [/b]We've completely overhauled game balance for a more engaging experience.
[*] New Boss Encounters: Introducing 6 unique bosses that emerge at specific times throughout the game for epic battles.
[*][b] Roll Action[/b]: Players can now press the alt key or left joystick to roll, gaining 0.3 seconds of invincibility.
[*] [b]Monster Animation Overhaul[/b]: Revamped attack animations with enhanced visual effects make encounters more dynamic.
[*][b] AI Improvements[/b]: Enemy AI has been upgraded for smarter, more challenging engagements.
[*] [b]Cool New Mutations[/b]:
     [b]Hydra's Grasp[/b]: Unleash tentacles that damage nearby foes with the sea's might.
     [b]Seeker's Blades[/b]: Deploy daggers that independently target and attack enemies.
[*] [b]Third Weapon Slot[/b]: Customize your arsenal further with the option to equip a second auto-weapon.
[*] [b]Mutation UI Enhancements[/b]: Easily view your current mutations during looting.
[*] [b]Damage Number Simplification[/b]: Color-coded for quick recognition - white for direct damage, red for DoT, blue for elemental reactions, and yellow for critical hits.
[*] [b]Visual Effects Upgrades[/b]: Numerous improvements across the game for a visually stunning experience.
[*] [b]UI and Bug Fixes[/b]: Streamlined mutation management and squashed several bugs for smoother gameplay.
[/list]

Get ready to dive back in for the second round of private testing starting tomorrow! Your feedback is crucial to making X-Mutation the best it can be.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We can't wait to see how you enjoy the new changes!


X-Mutation Dev Team

notes.title: Updates v0.2.03
notes.content:
Updates v0.2.03

Following the invaluable feedback from our first round of private testing, we've implemented several enhancements and fixes to improve your gameplay experience:

[list]
[*] Now, attributes boosted 2x during level-up are clearly marked.
[*] Optimized spider animation speeds for smoother gameplay.
[*] Eliminated duplicate attribute listings during mutation level-ups.
[*] Added comprehensive explanations for ranks and enchantments upon leveling up.
[*] Improved the visibility of the player icon on the minimap.
[*] Surviving more than 5 minutes now rewards an extra talent point.
[*] New text descriptions clarify the objectives of Crisis Events.
[*] Graphic hints now guide you to mutation loot crates.
[*] Adjusted the BGM volume on the splash screen for better audio balance.
[*] Updated the stat text colors in the ESC menu for improved readability.
[*] Corrected various typos to enhance game clarity.
[*] Increased mutation crate availability in early match stages.
[*] Introduced a UI feature displaying current mutations on the looting screen.
[*] Balanced monster power for a fairer challenge.
[*] The Level Up screen background is now transparent.
[*] Lowered the BGM volume during mutation looting for an enhanced audio experience.
[*] Monsters can now only ascend one block, adding strategic depth to terrain use.
[*] Added a skip button for quicker looting interactions.
[*] Boosted enemy speed and HP for a heightened challenge.
[*] Enhanced the damage number's font for better visibility.
[/list]

Your support fuels our passion and dedication to making [X-Mutation] even more engaging and enjoyable. We're committed to continually refining the game based on your input.



Thank you for being part of our journey!

X-Mutation Dev Team
